cells.gaps: No source found says a body is designated by law or decree with a mandate over AI; the HAPDP receives declarations as the data regulator. No enforcement decision is held.
cells.note: A jurist says Law 2022-59 on personal data applies to AI and obliges AI developers and providers to declare to the HAPDP, a rule in force that meets question 2. The HAPDP acts as the data regulator, with no designation over AI shown, as for Senegal.
